title_en: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Six
body_ar: فلم يترك الترمذي بابا من أبواب العلم إلا وأورده في كتابه بخلاف سنن أبي داود مثلا فلا تجد فيه المناقب ولا السير ولا فضائل القرآن ولا غير ذلك مما ذكره الترمذي في كتابه، وكتاب الترمذي هذا لا يوجد اليوم إلا من رواية ابن محبوب فقط. الوجه الثاني : أنه مستخرج على الصحيحين فالحديث إذا وجده من غير طريق الشيخين أو رده من غير طريقهما ، ثم يقول بعد ذلك وفي الباب عن فلان وفلان من الصحابة ، ولا يورد الحديث المشهور الذي في الصحيحين في الغالب ، مثلا إذا كان الحديث يوجد في الصحيحين من رواية أبي هريرة ووجده الترمذي من رواية أنس فيأتي به من رواية أنس ثم يقول وفي الباب عن أبي هريرة ، يلمح إلى الحديث المشهور.
body_en: Al-Tirmidhi left no chapter of the chapters of knowledge without bringing it into his book — unlike the Sunan of Abu Dawud, for example, in which you will find neither the chapters on merits, nor the biographies, nor the virtues of the Qur'an, nor anything else of what al-Tirmidhi mentioned in his book. This book of al-Tirmidhi is found today only through the transmission of Ibn Mahbub, and through no other. The second aspect: that it is an extraction (mustakhraj) made upon the two Ṣaḥīḥs. So when he finds the prophetic report (ḥadīth) by a route other than that of the two shaykhs, or [cites] it by a route other than theirs, he then says afterwards: "and in this chapter there is [a report] from so-and-so and so-and-so among the Companions"; and for the most part he does not bring the well-known report that is in the two Ṣaḥīḥs. For example, if the report is found in the two Ṣaḥīḥs by the transmission of Abu Hurayrah, and al-Tirmidhi finds it by the transmission of Anas, he brings it by Anas's transmission, then says "and in this chapter from Abu Hurayrah", alluding to the well-known report.

flags.arabic: فالحديث إذا وجده من غير طريق الشيخين أو رده من غير طريقهما
flags.context: the description of al-Tirmidhi's method with regard to the two Sahihs
options: read 'أو رده' as 'أورده' (or cites it), which the sentence requires
flags.note: 'أو رده' as served makes no sense in the sentence: 'or rejects it by a route other than theirs' does not parse. A word boundary has almost certainly shifted, giving 'أو رده' for 'أورده' (or cites it). Left as served in body_ar and bracketed in the English so the repair is visible rather than silent. Either of the first two readings leaves the sense of the passage unchanged.

translator_notes: A description of the method of the Jami' of al-Tirmidhi, part of a course lesson on the hadith literature. No rulings are given.
'الشيخين' here means al-Bukhari and Muslim, as the surrounding sentences make explicit; rendered 'the two shaykhs' with 'the two Ṣaḥīḥs' alongside so the reference is unambiguous.
'mustakhraj' is a technical hadith term with no glossary entry; it is glossed on first occurrence as 'an extraction'.
